column4: 4.608 MHz: made of the master clock with a phase accumulator, 24 cycles in 625 ticks, an edge off by one tick at most
the power-on reset: C3 holds RESET low as the supply rises; brought out, the bench (or the core) holds it low after power-on
the pads to the matrix board: the keys, a module of their own, drive ГР from ВР; the indicators are read off their pads
the cable to the computer: Вход in
the bell: its line (~D2.6, D2.3's output) is read off the board
the key's pulse from D10 into VT1: the threshold amplifier passes the line D10 picks as a logic level (ТО 5.2: a pressed key gives D9 a positive pulse)
the amplifier stage, base to collector: its inversion and the comparator's are one sense together, as ТО 5.2 says
VT1's collector to D9's IN-, through C6: the average, ever below a key's pulse
D9's IN- at the signal's average: low in logic
IN+'s divider to ground: the line D10 drives
D11's PRE and D held high
ГР3 to ground: no key's pulse on it
the СТОП КАДР indicator's series resistor
